thesis: Stage an emergence from void — deep violet darkness slowly blooming through rose and magenta into a single blazing white catharsis of rebirth, then letting the violet reclaim what the light revealed.

artist_branding.summary: Blooom (Oliver Torr) is a Berlin-based deep/melodic house producer known for emotional, introspective electronic music. His aesthetic sits in Berlin underground territory — not Afterlife cinematic restraint, not rave maximalism, but something between: dark, spacious, soul-driven. Wolfy Lights adds vocal intimacy that elevates the emotional register. Together 'Born Again' reads as spiritual rebirth music — deeply felt, not decorative. Visual world: darkness as canvas, light earned through the music's emotional journey, deep colour over saturation.
visual_cues: Berlin underground spatial aesthetic: movers as single beams cutting through dark, not busy fixture choreography
Emotional colour arc: violet/purple as the base world, warmth earned by the vocal and energy arc
Vocal moments deserve restraint — when Wolfy Lights sings, the rig should listen, not compete
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce Blooom's specific festival or club production design directly.

motifs: Void-to-light arc: the show literally enacts rebirth — total darkness opening into violet, then rose, then cathartic white. The bridge is the last dark before the light.
Violet as home: deep violet/purple is the soul colour of this track — pre-birth, post-death, the space between states. Return to it in the outro.
White as rebirth moment: the only time white appears is at the peak of the final chorus (2:29+) — the moment of 'born again'. Before this, never pure white.

visual_direction.color_story: Open in near-black with a deep violet tint (not total black — the soul is present). Verse breathes dim violet. First chorus blooms into richer violet/purple. Second chorus shifts toward rose-magenta (emotional warmth emerging). Bridge strips back to near-darkness — the final void. Final chorus: violet opens to rose, then at the peak (2:29) bursts into warm white. Outro: white drains back to deep violet as the song fades.
visual_direction.motion_story: All movers as a single unified organism — slow 2-bar sweeps, always synchronised. Verse: tight at DSC, nearly still. Chorus 1: slow arc from DSC outward. Chorus 2: wider, reaching. Bridge: park at DSC, dim. Final chorus: widest sweeps, converging to DSC at peak. The motion should feel like breathing — in at the dark, out at the light.
visual_direction.staging_story: No lasers until the very end of final chorus (2:29+) — the white moment. No strobe. Profile as vocal spotlight — when Wolfy Lights sings exposed phrases, Profile dims down to let the voice fill the space. NI3K halos track the colour arc (violet → rose → white). The 4BAR provides the colour world foundation.

must_include: Near-black verse opening — the void before birth
Deep violet as the primary colour world throughout
Warm white catharsis at peak (2:29+) — the 'born again' moment, nowhere else
Bridge near-darkness: strip to minimal before final chorus
avoid: Strobe at any point — this is emotional and spiritual, not aggressive
Saturated neon or rainbow effects — keep colour desaturated and deep
Busy fixture movement — all motion is slow unified breathing
Lasers before the white peak moment (2:29)
